protocol.question: Does a training-only global GMM regime gate improve fixed shared direction economics over the same ungated predictions, with actual bear coverage?

labels.classes: SHORT below -37bp; LONG above +37bp; CASH otherwise; missing future stays missing

protocol.adoption: Keep gate as research component only if net or DD or Sharpe improves versus matched ungated account in all four cost/unit scenarios. Short alpha claim requires positive SHORT contribution after costs in learned BEAR across four scenarios and adequate evidence; no investment qualification. If no consistent benefit pause recipe; no refit/search.
protocol.stopping: One GMM fit and one scaler fit; init random_from_data n_init1 no kmeans fit; zero direction fits; 16 new 122day continuous accounts. Nonconvergence stops without tuning. No future fit, no locked or higher risk.

regime.crash_override: Past BTC1d return below -5pct and past30d annualvol above80pct -> HIGH_VOL_CRASH
regime.policy: BULL allows original LONG; BEAR allows original SHORT; SIDEWAYS/HIGH_VOL_CRASH -> CASH; reject never invert; risk reduction remains active
regime.mapping: Sort training standardized return20+MA200distance+breadth centre sum: lowest BEAR, middle SIDEWAYS, highest BULL; descriptive relative states not truth

direction_model_reuse.availability: Retrospective replay with identical preMarch fit data cutoff; not actual historical deployed model, no validation early stopping or parameter choice
